expect.pass: with no AGENT_OPS_STATE_DIR and no NO_SEND, every maintenance python resolves state under ~/.local/state/capsule-corp/maint, never under the checkout or the vault symlink
AGENT_OPS_STATE_DIR moves every python constant and every shell script's state dir to that one path
the maintenance modules copied to another directory resolve the same state root as the original, so a release checkout and the dev checkout share one state
a shell job that sourced lib_state.sh with no env exports no AGENT_OPS_STATE_DIR, so a child it starts with AGENT_OPS_NO_SEND=1 resolves the NO_SEND temp dir, never ~/.local/state/capsule-corp/maint
